summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found from reading the code (no changes made)  The happy-path wiring is actually correct: cookie-based sessions (`arca_session`), the client always sends `credentials: "include"`, and every watchlist query (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`) filters strictly by `user_id`. There's no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist UI. So this isn't a "watchlists aren't scoped to accounts" problem — the DB and route logic already do that.  Three things stood out as the most likely places a real bug is hidi
